flash_691852.description: The body of a 66-year-old Israeli citizen who went missing during a solo cycling trip in Finland last week has been discovered by the roadside.

flash_691854.description: Citing high expenses and his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, President Donald Trump orders Secretary of War Pete Hegseth to scale back drills with South Korea.

flash_691853.description:
A 31-year-old man was seriously injured in a road accident near the Moshe Dayan Interchange.

Magen David Adom paramedics evacuated him to Wolfson Hospital in Holon.

flash_691856.description: Following high-level talks in Egypt with US envoy Jared Kushner, Hamas demands the Board of Peace compel Israel to fulfill its commitments under the Gaza plan.

flash_691855.description:
A man in his 50s was moderately injured in a two-car collision on Highway 4 near Regba Junction.

Magen David Adom EMTs and paramedics provided medical treatment at the scene and evacuated him to the Galilee Medical Center in Nahariya.

flash_691859.description:
South Korea's Ministry of Defense announced that joint military exercises with the United States military "will take place as scheduled."

The announcement comes as a direct response to statements by US President Donald Trump, who announced he had ordered a significant scale-back of joint training due to his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

flash_691858.description: French police launch a criminal probe into a resort cafeteria owner filmed telling a Jewish customer there were "too many Jews" and denying service.

flash_691863.description: Middle East analyst Zvi Yehezkeli harshly criticizes Jared Kushner’s meeting with senior Hamas officials in Egypt: "The very occurrence of this meeting is a victory for Hamas - legitimizing and normalizing the group."

flash_691862.description: Iran's parliament speaker declares victory over the US and Israel, after officials reject Donald Trump's assertion that the US will control the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_691860.description: Ship tracking data shows transit through the Strait of Hormuz nearly stopped over the weekend following attacks on UAE vessels and stalled US-Iran talks.

flash_691857.description:
US President Donald Trump on Sunday praised Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan for the joint defense agreement they recently signed.

"Very happy to see that Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have recently, and finally, signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement. It shows how the Middle East is coming together, and how Countries will finally be able to defend themselves in a more meaningful way. Congratulations to the Great Leadership of the three Nations mentioned. THIS IS A BIG, BOLD, AND IMPORTANT FIRST STEP - WOW!" wrote Trump in a post on Truth Social.

flash_691866.description: Fox News survey places Republican Mike Rogers ahead of anti-Israel Democrat Abdul El-Sayed 51% to 47% in Michigan's Senate contest.

flash_691865.description:
American actress Hayden Panettiere has passed away at the age of 36. Panettiere was widely known for her roles in the hit US television series "Heroes" and "Nashville."

US media outlets reporting her death did not provide details regarding the cause or circumstances of her passing.

flash_691861.description:
A 5.8-magnitude earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in Indonesia.

No injuries or damage have been reported so far.

flash_691864.description: Iran's parliament approves a bill penalizing unauthorized interviews with hostile media with up to two years in prison, alongside strict curbs on foreign contact.

flash_691871.description: Jewish watchdog urges NYPD to increase officers in hot spots after synagogue attack.

flash_691870.description:
Police arrested a Jaffa resident in his 20s on suspicion of vandalizing and causing extensive damage at the Church of Saint Anthony in the city.

During the incident, several statues in the church compound were knocked over and broken, while broken crosses were found on the floor and chairs. The suspect was arrested by police and taken to the station for further questioning.

flash_691868.description: According to reports from Gaza, Air Force aircraft carried out targeted strikes this morning against targets and areas in eastern Gaza City.

flash_691874.description: After two soldiers were wounded by FPV drones and the rescue robot was hit, company commander Vladislav Polsky went in without body armor, loaded them into a civilian pickup, and brought them to safety.

flash_691873.description: Extremist elements in Iranian leadership decided to utilize ceasefire period granted by Iran-US memorandum of understanding to prepare for future conflict, Wall Street Journal report reveals.

flash_691869.description:
Lebanese Al Mayadeen TV, which is affiliated with the Hezbollah terrorist organization, reported a strike in the village of Al-Qantara in southern Lebanon overnight.

Artillery strikes were also reported in the area of the village of Al-Mansouri and in the Wadi al-Saluki area in southern Lebanon.

flash_691867.description: German weekly Der Spiegel calls AfD candidate Ulrich Siegmund 'Germany’s most dangerous man,' who could become the far-right party’s first state premier in Saxony-Anhalt, marking a historic turning point in German politics.

flash_691880.description: The Israeli High Court has a long record of flouting the law when it comes to Arab parties’ participation in Knesset elections. But in the post-October 7th era, in which the vulnerability of the state was so vividly exposed, it is essential to vigorously enforce both the spirit and the letter of Clause 7(a) of the Basic Law: The Knesset. Opinion.

flash_691879.description: Col. Yossi Pinto, head of Israeli delegation to Colombia, describes the search for missing people one week after the earthquake, 'We have yet to find any survivors, but Israelis don't give up.'

flash_691877.description: Iran won’t come to the table and Hamas won’t disarm. But as luck would have it Iran, unsuspecting and all, can help Trump gain pole position. Opinion.

flash_691875.description: Residents returning to Givat Tel Talpiot following violent demolition say religious items, credit card, and thousands of shekels missing, and belongings destroyed.

flash_691872.description: Israel needs a doctrine of strategic prevention and overwhelming deterrence. We need to ensure that no potential coalition can ever become sufficiently confident in its ability to overwhelm Israel that it concludes an attack is worth the risk.

flash_691881.description: Over 45,000 Israelis expected to make annual pilgrimage to Uman Ukraine, despite closed Ukrainian airspace, martial law, and a grueling journey across the border.

flash_691878.description: A house can contain people who are different from one another, each with his own character and his own way, and yet they are all living under the same roof. That is the picture we should have of Am Yisrael.

flash_691876.description: Michal and Tal had planned to get married a year from now, but Michal’s mother’s medical condition led them to move up the wedding and hold it at Shaare Zedek Medical Center.

flash_691883.description: Border Police raid Golani live-fire zone after herds repeatedly entered military training areas, forcing IDF exercises to be disrupted or halted. Watch.

flash_691882.description: High Follow-Up Committee delegation visits Temple Mount, Islamic Movement leader shares religious justification for Ra'am's efforts to join center-left government after elections.

flash_691884.description: 14,307 Likud members already exercised their right to vote in Likud primaries. Gotliv claims ballots without her name, Yoni Yosef withdraws candidacy, and Netanyahu expresses support for Osnat Zohar.

flash_691886.description: Seven Jewish tourists from France were attacked by hundreds at the port of Barcelona and subjected to 40 minutes of curses, spitting, and chants against Jews and Israel.

flash_691885.description: Family calls on the public to pray and increase Torah study and good deeds for Rabbi Shalom Pinchas Burstein. 'He is in need of great Heavenly mercy.'

flash_691892.description: US President declines to endorse a candidate in Israel's upcoming elections, but leaves open possibility he could do so later.

flash_691891.description: The power of teshuvah is not limited, it encompasses every domain of life, that of the individual and that of civilization as a whole.

flash_691890.description: The Houthi military spokesman, Yahya Saree, confirmed that the rebel organization attacked a Saudi naval landing ship and four other military boats in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait with ballistic missiles.

flash_691889.description: US President Donald Trump tells Fox News that he will bomb Oman if they 'get in the way,' insists Hamas will disarm.

flash_691888.description: Border Police arrest Qalandiya resident suspected of working to dig tunnel to infiltrate Israel.

flash_691887.description: Three members of Shas' Kiryat Gat slate defect to rival Ahi party, citing Shas' opposition to IDF enlistment for haredim not studying in yeshiva.

flash_691900.description: As government pushes core curriculum, severe teacher shortage prompting haredi leaders to confront deeper problem.

flash_691899.description: Hanan Breuer, who lost his wife Mor shortly after the birth of their son, and Hila Klein, the widow of Elhanan Klein, who was murdered in a terrorist attack, have built a new home together.

flash_691897.description:
A senior Iranian official threatened that Iran has decided to shift its policy from defensive to "completely offensive," Reuters reported.

The official claimed that Iran has set a deadline of several weeks for the US to fully enforce the memorandum of understanding. "All Iranian entities are ready to escalate tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and the region if diplomacy fails. Iran's timetable will be conveyed to the US through intermediary countries. Iran will not wait for the US to continue its naval blockade forever."

flash_691896.description: For the 31st year, one Chicago high school's raffle sends a family to Yerushalayim for Sukkos; drawing September 3rd.

flash_691895.description: UN Rapporteur Albanese said the death toll in Gaza was 680,000 (it’s 70,000 including terrorists), including 380,000 infants under five. When told there were only 341,790 children under five in Gaza to begin with, Albanese said she lied deliberately because “it had the effect I wanted".

flash_691894.description: Transportation Minister Miri Regev claims that the El Al workers’ committee is working against her in the Likud primaries.

flash_691893.description: Directing attention toward bodily sensations reduces inflammation, accelerates recovery in healthy volunteers, new study shows.

flash_691906.description: In 4-hour meeting with Israeli PM, US envoy Jared Kushner presses Israel to implement the 15-point Gaza peace plan.

flash_691905.description: President Isaac Herzog meets Jared Kushner and Nickolay Mladenov in Jerusalem, stresses Israel's security must remain central to Gaza plan.

flash_691904.description: Netanyahu meets US envoy Jared Kushner

flash_691903.description: 2 children injured in Beit Shemesh, 1 unconscious

flash_691902.description:
A 62-year-old Israeli citizen, a resident of Petah Tikva, died in Peru after being imprisoned in the country for about three and a half years.

Upon receiving the report, ZAKA's international unit began working together with the Foreign Ministry, the family, and local authorities in Peru, with the aim of arranging all the necessary procedures and bringing his coffin for burial in Israel.

flash_691901.description: Yisrael Beytenu Chairman Avigdor Liberman sets coalition red lines, ruling out a minority government and demanding military or civilian service for all Israelis.

flash_691898.description: Who gave one unelected official, Gali Baharav-Miara, this much power? Opinion.

flash_691908.description: One of the two children who were stabbed in Beit Shemesh has been declared dead.

flash_691910.description: I heard my 11-year-old son Eli shouting across an otherwise tranquil resort pool: “AM YISRAEL CHAI!" Loudly, very loudly. And at first, I was worried.

flash_691907.description: Another antisemitic attack on American Jews at prayer. This one happened inside the most politically connected Reform synagogue in the country, a place where Israel has been condemned.

flash_691912.description: A four-year-old boy was critically injured after being struck by a car in Beit Shemesh. Magen David Adom teams dispatched to the scene performed resuscitation efforts, but were ultimately forced to pronounce him dead.

flash_691911.description: An Edinburgh venue admits it unlawfully discriminated against Jewish comedian Philip Simon after cancelling his Fringe show over his views on Israel and Gaza.

flash_691909.description: The Prime Minister's Office stated: "The Prime Minister and Board of Peace had deep and constructive discussions. It was agreed to establish two working groups, one on disarmament and demilitarisation of Gaza, which both Israel and the Board of Peace are determined should be prompt and completed before any reconstruction happens in Gaza. A second working group will focus on sanitation, clean water and other public health issues for the people of Gaza and which also impact the people of Israel."

flash_691914.description: The father of fallen surveillance soldier Roni Eshel published a painful post against Brig. Gen. Yossi Sariel, who commanded Unit 8200 on October 7.

flash_691913.description: Former hostage Yosef Haim Ohana visits the Gush Katif Museum and reflects on Jewish life in Gaza, his captivity, and an emotional mitzvah with his father.

flash_691917.description: Following meetings between the Prime Minister and Trump administration envoys, troops in the Gaza Strip have officially been prohibited from continuing to expand the area under Israeli control.

flash_691916.description: Israeli rescuers are working alongside Colombian teams at a six-story building collapse site in Cali, while engineers assess wider structural damage following a powerful earthquake.

flash_691915.description: For 30 years they guarded this city. Now almost $300,000 prevents their yeshiva from finishing what they started.

flash_691919.description: Morton Klein condemns grants from Steven Spielberg's Righteous Persons Foundation to progressive Jewish organizations critical of Israel, saying profits from Schindler's List are being used to support groups that endanger Jews.

flash_691918.description: Trump on the Strait of Hormuz: 'I like the idea of declaring it a territory'

flash_691921.description: Forty-four percent of American Jews view Mamdani favorably. That did not happen organically. It is due to the work of a progressive Jewish infrastructure funded by Diaspora liberal Jews. Report.

flash_691920.description: President Trump's envoy and son-in-law says concerns raised by Netanyahu during four-hour meeting were addressed, stresses Israel will retain right to defend itself. On Hamas: 'We’re going to give them a chance to perform.'

flash_691923.description: President Trump declares he will not extend the framework deal with Iran, while maintaining the US holds "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_691922.description: In a targeted operation, IDF searches roughly 100 structures and detains suspects. Simultaneously, elite Duvdevan unit apprehends two wanted individuals suspected of planning and executing terror attacks.

flash_691925.description: Rabbi Yerucham Smotrich and his son, Minister Bezalel Smotrich, dance alongside Avraham Fried at the International Convention Center in Jerusalem.

flash_691924.description:
Minister May Golan and Member of Knesset Amit Halevi have submitted urgent complaints to the Likud party’s Central Election Committee, alleging severe forgery during the vote counting at the polling station in Yeruham.

The two are demanding an immediate halt to the counting process at the site, pointing to repeated incidents of erasures, alterations, and marking of votes that did not match the names of the candidates actually being read aloud.

flash_691928.description:
The vote counting in the Likud primary election is underway, with initial data following the counting of approximately 11% of polling stations indicating that Minister Eli Cohen holds first place.

Alongside him at the top of the national list are Speaker of the Knesset Amir Ohana, Deputy Prime Minister and Justice Minister Yariv Levin, Coalition Chairman Ofir Katz, and Transportation Minister Miri Regev.

flash_691927.description: Turkish President Erdogan criticizes Israeli actions in Gaza during a phone call with President Trump while emphasizing regional diplomacy and defense pacts.

flash_691926.description:
Police arrested two 16-year-olds at Sammy Ofer Stadium on suspicion of assaulting two other minors at the Haifa Mall.

Police stated that there is no connection between the assault incident and the soccer match which took place at the stadium.

flash_691932.description: With approximately 25% of the Likud primary votes counted, Eli Cohen, Yariv Levin, and Amir Ohana lead the standings, followed by Miri Regev, Miki Zohar, Yoav Kisch, Ofir Katz, Almog Cohen, Amichai Chikli, Dudi Amsalem, Moshe Saada, Tally Gotliv, David Bitan, Nir Barkat, Avihai Boaron, Shlomo Karhi, and Boaz Bismuth.

flash_691931.description: Vote counting in the Likud primaries continues, with preliminary results placing Eli Cohen, Yariv Levin, and Amir Ohana at the top of the board.

flash_691930.description: Associates of the Prime Minister plan to screen and disqualify haredi party members who do not support Likud once the primary election process concludes.

flash_691938.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham exchanged text messages with an imposter claiming to be White House chief of staff Susie Wiles before suspecting a fraud.

flash_691937.description: Congressional leaders from both parties condemn Dan Bilzerian's antisemitic attacks against Jewish Rep. Randy Fine as primary contests heat up across Florida.

flash_691936.description:
With approximately 50% of the votes cast by party members in the primary to determine the Knesset list counted, Minister Eli Cohen is in first place, followed by Minister Yariv Levin, Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana, Minister Miri Regev, and Coalition Chairman Ofir Katz.

Rounding out the top 10 are Minister Miki Zohar, Minister Yoav Kisch, Almog Cohen, Minister Amichai Chikli, and MK Moshe Saada.

flash_691935.description: Likud primaries | With 45% of votes counted: Eli Cohen, Yariv Levin, and Amir Ohana still lead

flash_691934.description:
With approximately 35% of the votes cast by Likud party members in the primary to determine the Knesset slate counted, Eli Cohen, Yariv Levin, and Amir Ohana are leading the list, followed by Miri Regev, Ofir Katz, Miki Zohar, Yoav Kisch, Almog Cohen, Amichai Chikli, and Moshe Saada.

Places 11 through 15 are held by Dudi Amsalem, Tally Gotliv, Shlomo Karhi, David Bitan, and Nir Barkat.

flash_691933.description: President Donald Trump claims North Korea's leader responded to his overtures after ordering a scale-back of joint US military exercises with South Korea.

flash_691929.description:
A 31-year-old man was moderately injured when his car overturned on Route 444 at the entrance to Tayibe.

Magen David Adom EMTs and paramedics treated him at the scene and evacuated him to Meir Hospital in Kfar Saba.

flash_691941.description: Likud primaries: Ohana rises to second place instead of Levin, Amsalem in 9th

flash_691940.description: Iran's IRGC dismisses Trump's claims of backchannel talks, as Trump rules out extending the June framework deal.

flash_691942.description: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun urges extending UNIFIL's mandate, while saying Lebanon will not retreat from its framework agreement with Israel.

flash_691939.description:
With approximately 65% of the votes cast by Likud party members in the primary to determine the Knesset list counted, Minister Eli Cohen is in first place, followed by Minister Yariv Levin, Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana, Minister Miri Regev, and Coalition Chairman Ofir Katz.

Rounding out the top 10 are Minister Yoav Kisch, Minister Miki Zohar, Almog Cohen, MK Dudi Amsalem, and Minister Amichai Chikli.

In places 11 through 16 are MK Moshe Saada, MK Tally Gotliv, MK David Bitan, Minister Shlomo Karhi, Minister Nir Barkat, and MK Boaz Bismuth.

flash_691946.description: Europe continues to talk of “sovereignty" while it has progressively replaced the government of peoples with the administration of flows of migrants. Opinion.

flash_691945.description: When the headlines expressed shock that Saudi Arabia chose Ankara and Islamabad over Jerusalem, the honest response should have been: what did you expect? Opinion.

flash_691943.description: Hillel Mordechai Dadon’s family is struggling to comprehend his death, as relatives describe unbearable grief following the fatal Beit Shemesh stabbing.

flash_691954.description: Not a few judicial decisions have harmed deterrence against the enemy and the IDF’s ability to defend Israel and defeat the enemy. What is the halakhic status of the state court system?

flash_691953.description: IDF: Increased aircraft activity this afternoon; no concern of a security incident

flash_691951.description: IDF representatives inform the family of Yehuda Katz that his remains have been located, 44 years after he went missing in the Battle of Sultan Yaqub.

flash_691950.description: The 5-Step Program of Spiritual Courtship, Engagement, Marriage, Honeymoon, and Real Life.

flash_691949.description: A long-forgotten danger erupted in orchards near Metula when unexploded ordnance detonated, seriously injuring two Thai workers and sending six people to the hospital.

flash_691948.description:
A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a false target in the area of Zar'it.

No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.

There is no risk of a security incident. The incident is under review.

flash_691947.description: Israel has reportedly withdrawn from Gaza’s Orange Line to the original Yellow Line amid US pressure, reducing its control of the enclave from over 60% to only 53%.

flash_691944.description: Arab media reports four airstrikes targeting a military airport near Aleppo, with some sources suggesting Israeli aircraft were involved.

flash_691956.description: A summer flight to Crete turned into a nightmare as passengers, including young children, were left waiting inside a Bluebird aircraft without air conditioning for nearly two hours.

flash_691955.description: Vote counting in the Likud primaries continues, with preliminary results placing Eli Cohen, Yariv Levin, and Amir Ohana at the top of the board.

flash_691952.description: The Tanya compacts four millennia of Jewish wisdom to answer the great personal and existential questions of life. It has revolutionized the way we think about G -d the human soul, the world and our place in it.

flash_691958.description:
The Israel Police and Shin Bet arrested a resident of the Negev who is suspected of having contact with a foreign agent, possessing weapons, and planning terrorist activity and an attack in Be’er Sheva.

The State Attorney’s Office filed a serious indictment against him this morning.

flash_691957.description: IDF eliminates Islamic Jihad commander Tareq Anwar Khamis Ra'i, who infiltrated Kibbutz Be'eri on October 7 and took part in abducting an Israeli civilian.

flash_691960.description: After 44 years of uncertainty, Rabbi Yuval Cherlow reflects on the identification of Yehuda Katz’s remains, describing a moment of profound pain, consolation and renewed hope for his family.

flash_691959.description: A 20-year-old Negev resident is indicted for allegedly planning an ISIS-inspired attack on a Be’er Sheva nightclub and seeking to join the terror group in Syria.

flash_691962.description: A new complaint accuses Border Police officers of assaulting a minor, using gas at protesters, and allegedly taking a credit card during the evacuation of the Tel Talpiyot outpost.

flash_691961.description: Bank Leumi sues Meta for NIS 26.6 million, alleging Facebook and Instagram allowed fraudulent ads impersonating the bank and targeting customers.

flash_691967.description: Trump posts map labeling Strait of Hormuz as 'New US Territory'

flash_691966.description: Police arrested two masked teens from Pisgat Ze'ev after finding two suspected Molotov cocktails in a bag they allegedly discarded in Arnona.

flash_691965.description:
US Envoy to Syria Tom Barrack accused Israel of carrying out airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur Airbase in Syria, calling the strikes an “unnecessary escalation" that does not advance regional stability. Israel has not acknowledged the strike.

Barrack said the Al-Sharra government has not adopted a “predatory posture" or maintained proxy forces, and has repeatedly indicated a preference for de-escalation with Israel. He said the US would continue to host discussions aimed at encouraging diplomacy over military action.

“The United States continues to believe that restraint and engagement offer the more constructive course," Barrack said, urging all parties to prioritize dialogue over further military incidents.

flash_691964.description: Trump threatened Oman amid concerns over its Iran ties as Washington seeks a nuclear deal with Tehran and the full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_691971.description: Congregant Harry Zimmerman accuses New York Times of failing to accurately report on and downplaying an antisemitic attack in an NYC synagogue.

flash_691970.description: Jerusalem court sentences Nabil Shaabani to prison and compensation for attempted nationalistically motivated murder and theft.

flash_691969.description: Security forces raided a Hebron home after midnight and arrested a 37-year-old woman accused of severe incitement, supporting terrorism and glorifying terrorists in social media posts.

flash_691968.description: Suggestions for summer reading that are relevant and even hopefully impactful. Op-ed.

flash_691963.description: FBI data shows Jews remained the most targeted religious group in US hate crimes in 2025, accounting for 64% of religion-based incidents.

flash_691972.description: The NBA legend, who became an Israeli citizen and converted to Judaism, reflects on his years playing in Israel and the deeper purpose behind his journey.

flash_691975.description: Syrian Foreign Minister announces that the IAEA will receive access to a site in Deir ez-Zor after more than 18 years, effectively confirming the presence of nuclear material in the country.

flash_691974.description: Puah Institute halachic adviser Rabbi Gideon Weitzman explains the possible halachic implications of the Assuta IVF incident and the safeguards designed to prevent errors during fertility treatments.

flash_691977.description: He rescued tens of thousands of Jews, redeemed Sweden’s compromised wartime reputation, and became one of history’s greatest humanitarians. Then Stockholm abandoned its own diplomat to Stalin’s prisons-and left his desperate mother to fight largely alone. Op-ed.

flash_691976.description: Ashkelon resident for alleged cyber attacks on dozens of Israeli companies.

flash_691981.description: A summary of the latest draft year finds that Haredim account for about 80% of all draft dodgers. The Attorney General is demanding expanded sanctions and the resumption of proactive arrests.

flash_691980.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated: "My wife Sara and I mourn the deep pain of Tamar and Amos Dadon, whose son Hillel Mordechai, of blessed memory, was brutally murdered last night in Beit Shemesh. We pray for the well-being of the other child who was injured in the incident and wish him a swift and complete recovery. Our hearts are with the Dadon family and with the residents of Beit Shemesh in this difficult and painful hour."

flash_691978.description: Ministries of Health and Environmental Protection warn against entering several streams in the north after water tests showed irregularities, including Banias, Hatzbani, Jordan, Meshusim, Gilabon, Zaki, Yehudiyah, Tzalmon and Kziv.

flash_691973.description: US President says no negotiations are scheduled as the 60-day ceasefire agreement nears its end.

flash_691983.description: Following the Colombian government’s declaration, operations are transitioning to the recovery phase.

flash_691982.description:
IDF, Military Intelligence and Mossad return remains of Staff Sgt. Yehuda Katz, who fell in the 1982 Battle of Sultan Yacoub and was missing for 44 years. His family was notified following his identification, completing the return of all missing soldiers from that battle.

Read More

flash_691979.description:
A short while ago, the IDF struck several Hamas commanders in the Shati area in the northern Gaza Strip.

The terrorists planned to carry out terror attacks against IDF troops operating in the Gaza Strip. The terrorists were struck in a precise aerial strike to remove the threat.

Prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance.

flash_691987.description: Abdullah Gargawi, with ties to ISIS, planned an attack at Beersheba’s Forum Club, 'I wanted to blow up the people dancing there - Jews or Arabs.'

flash_691986.description: The US has announced sanctions against the president of the International Criminal Court in The Hague.

flash_691985.description:
The IDF announced that in an attack earlier today, the IDF struck a meeting of Nukhba commanders, including a company commander, three platoon commanders, and several additional terrorists.

The terrorists advanced terror attacks against IDF troops operating in the Gaza Strip. One of the terrorists also infiltrated Israeli territory and participated in the October 7th Massacre.

Prior to the strike, measures were taken to mitigate harm to uninvolved civilians. The IDF will provide further updates on the results of the strike.

flash_691984.description: The Israel Dog Unit and Israel Prison Service are deepening cooperation, sharing expertise in working dogs, missing-person searches, and lifesaving operations during a professional meeting.

flash_691989.description: The number of Likud members in Har Hevron surged from around 150 to approximately 600, with 80% of them voting in the primaries. Erez Tadmor received the highest support.

flash_691988.description: Gilad Erdan, in an interview with Arutz Sheva, criticizes the changes in Likud, appeals to the Religious Zionist community, and presents his positions on the draft issue and the next government.

flash_691993.description: Why are we allowed to kill animals for food?

flash_691992.description: During a visit to Ariel University, Netanyahu met Amit, who was wounded by sniper fire in Gaza: “A moment that moved me deeply."

flash_691991.description: And also some information: The Jewish people are not foreign tourists or colonizers in Judea. We did not name ourselves after this land. This land was named after us.

flash_691996.description: The UAE suspends all trade, commercial exchanges and financial transactions with Iran, citing regional escalations that threaten peace and security.

flash_691995.description:
IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir spoke with the family of the late Yehuda Yekutiel Katz following the return of his remains to Israel. “Today, the circle has been closed. All those missing from the battle have been returned to Israel," he said.

The family thanked the Chief of Staff for his words and for the efforts to bring Yehuda home, to be buried in Israel. They added that his funeral will unite the entire nation and will be held in accordance with his unique character.

flash_691994.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Office on Tuesday evening issued an English-language statement commenting on the airstrikes in Syria the previous night.

"Israel and Syria agreed to a status quo in security matters, which Syria was on the verge of breaching by permitting Turkish troops to deploy at an airbase near Aleppo. Israel repeatedly warned Syria that such a deployment would pose a threat to Israel's security. Syria chose to ignore these warnings. Israel will not tolerate threats to its security, and would welcome a return to the status quo," the statement said.

flash_691990.description: Two polls published after the primaries place the Likud in first place with 31-32 seats, and Eisenkot’s party in second place with 24.

flash_691998.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announces sanctions against ICC President Tomoko Akane and senior lawyer Abdoulaye Seye. Netanyahu: The ICC has become a kangaroo court.

flash_691997.description:
Following the Israeli strike in Syria, a security source told Kan 11 News that Israel had recently sought to reach an understanding with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa through an indirect channel of communication. After the behind-the-scenes efforts failed, Israel provided the United States with intelligence indicating that Turkey was seeking to establish a presence at an airport in Syria, approximately 70 kilometers from the Israeli border. Israel argued that this constituted a violation of the understandings.

According to the source, after the talks failed and before Turkish forces arrived, Israel struck the Syrian base, where rehabilitation work had begun recently.

flash_692000.description: US envoy Tom Barrack says Israeli strikes in Syria highlight the need for Israel, Syria and Turkey to establish a mechanism to prevent escalation.

flash_691999.description: Lebanon's Al Mayadeen TV, which is affiliated with the Hezbollah terrorist organization, reported that the Israel Air Force carried out strikes on the outskirts of the town of Qantara, in the Ali Taher ridge area, and in the outskirts of Kfar Roummane in southern Lebanon.

flash_692003.description:
A 22-year-old electric scooter rider was seriously injured after crashing into a pole in Tel Aviv-Yafo.

Magen David Adom teams provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

flash_692002.description: President Trump is pushing aides to arrange a fall meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, seeking to revive stalled nuclear diplomacy, according to The Wall Street Journal.

flash_692001.description:
Two men were seriously and moderately injured in a shooting incident in Kafr Manda. Police have launched an investigation and are conducting searches for suspects.

According to police, the incident appears to be criminally motivated, and the circumstances are being investigated.

flash_692007.description: The US and South Korea are shortening joint military drills as Trump seeks renewed talks with Kim Jong Un and reportedly pushes for a fall meeting.

flash_692033.description:
The chairman of the Central Elections Committee, Justice Noam Sohlberg, ordered Together party leader Naftali Bennett on Wednesday to remove footage of soldiers engaged in operational activity and an IDF artillery cannon from an election campaign video.

In the video, Bennett refers, among other things, to soldiers who have been fighting for months while Haredim evade military service. As he discusses the soldiers, the footage appears in the background. The Likud Party argued that this constituted the use of public assets and the IDF for election campaigning, in violation of the law.

flash_692026.description: 'Together' chairman Naftali Bennett blasts 'Yashar!' chair Gadi Eisenkot's haredi draft plan and its 30% exemption proposal: 'We know exactly how it ends: with nothing.'

flash_692036.description:
The Lebanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Emigrants strongly condemned the Israeli airstrikes that targeted Abu al-Duhur Military Airport in Idlib Governorate on Tuesday. The Ministry stated that it considers these strikes a "blatant violation of the sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity of the Syrian Arab Republic, as well as a clear breach of international law and the Charter of the United Nations."

The Ministry reaffirmed Lebanon's "firm support for Syria's sovereignty, security and stability, and stresses Lebanon's rejection of any attack on Syrian territory. It further underscores the need to put an end to these violations and refrain from any steps that could heighten tensions and threaten regional stability."

flash_692035.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir clashed with a resident during a police tour of Basmat Tab'un, then praised a local driver's support for Israel.

flash_692034.description: Boaz Melet tells Arutz Sheva how his son Benayahu, who was shot in a terrorist attack, recovered and continued fighting the terrorists until his final moments.
